title: A call with a `: _*` argument as the surviving branch of an if with a constant condition is rejected: "Sequence argument type annotation `: _*` cannot be used here"
oracle: reference compile error on generated valid code (Scala 3.7.4 accepts it)
generator: wave4/harness/programs/Gen.scala, value-class family (Vs.f(a, xs: _*)) inside a generated if with a literal condition
signature: ref|compile-error|Sequence argument type annotation `: _*` cannot be used here:
detail: `final val Debug = false; def f(xs: Seq[Int]) = if (Debug) -1 else g(xs: _*)` fails to compile, as does `if (true) String.format(fmt, args: _*) else ""`. RefChecks replaces an if with a foldable constant condition by its surviving branch and then calls `res.transform(this)`, which transforms the branch's children without passing the branch itself through `RefChecks.transform`. When the branch is an application, the `Application` case that sets `currentApplication` is skipped, so `checkRepeatedParamArg` on the `: _*` argument sees the enclosing application (or none) and reports the argument as misplaced. Anything else the `Application` case does for the branch (bounds checks, sensibility warnings) is skipped too. Ordinary code reaches it through a constant feature flag in front of a varargs forwarding call. Present on the integration build, the base and 2.13.18; Scala 3.7.4 compiles and runs it.
fix_sketch: In the `If` case of `RefChecks.transform`, send a reduced branch through `transform(res)` rather than `res.transform(this)`. The current revision of retronym/scala#750 (GF1) makes this change for other reasons; the integration build carries an earlier revision of #750 without it. No compatibility cost beyond the warnings #750 already lists: the programs do not compile today.
prior: Same root cause as GF1's second half; fixed, by reading, in the current revision of retronym/scala#750 ('The if case also sends the surviving branch through the transform itself'), which has no test with a `: _*` argument; the integration build (w4-int, e298f8de2f) has the earlier revision 73152c2f02 and still fails. No scala/bug ticket found.
